meta.purpose: Global airport BHS / PBB / hold-baggage-screening (EDS·CBIS·HBS) tender tracker
meta.maintained_by: Claude scheduled routine (weekly digest on Fridays; mid-week runs accumulate state silently)

fx_note_2026.note: approximate Aug-2026 rates for threshold screening only; 1 crore INR ≈ 1.6억 KRW

runs.note: baseline — first run, no prior state to diff against; egress policy blocked direct attachment download so attachment accessibility is inferred

2nd run (mid-week accumulation). 4 parallel regional sweeps (India/S.Asia, Europe/MENA, Americas/Africa, APAC). Egress still blocks direct portal + attachment download → attachment accessibility inferred from search index. Per user rule the aggregated report is Friday-only, so this run updated state silently with NO user notification. New capital finds: Calgary YYC PBB, Detroit DTW jet-bridge Phase 5, Cape Town A3/A4 PBB refurb. Reclassified Patna (now out-of-window).

meta.verification_caveat: Direct fetch to procurement portals (TED, find-tender, SAM.gov, aai.aero, CIAL, etenders.gov.za, MERX, GeBIZ/Changi eProcure, Etimad, ComprasMX) is blocked by this environment's egress policy. Tender EXISTENCE is corroborated from search-engine indexing of the actual portal pages/PDFs (notice IDs, buyers, CPV/refs, dates), but attachment lists are NOT firsthand-verified and some dates/values remain unconfirmed. Items needing un-blocked verification are flagged per-entry.
